h: Late gospel singer Toluwanisings' father reportedly speaks on his son's move from Islam to Christianity
p: The father of the late gospel singer Toluwanisings has reportedly addressed his son's Muslim upbringing and later conversion to Christianity. The singer had said in an earlier interview that he grew up Muslim before becoming a Christian. The comments have drawn sympathetic reactions online.
more: The singer had described his conversion as the best choice of his life.
Tributes to him have continued since his death earlier this month.
